purpose: A strictly monotonic decline from the ATH has no confirmed pivot high below the anchor, so no second anchor exists and no line is fit: NO_VALID_SECOND_ANCHOR (an explicit 'no signal' state, not an error).

expected_second_anchor.reason: No confirmed pivot high exists below the ATH; every bar high is strictly lower than the prior bar, so H[p] > H[p-1] is never satisfied.

rejection_rationale.candidate: Any bar as a second-anchor pivot high
rejection_rationale.rejected_because: A pivot high requires H[p] > H[p-i] for i=1..k, but the series is strictly decreasing, so no bar is a local maximum on its left.
rejection_rationale.numeric: For every p>=1: H[p] < H[p-1] (e.g. H[1]=98 < H[0]=100; H[2]=96 < H[1]=98; ...) -> isPivotHigh false for all p.

rejection_rationale.rejected_because: Per §10.4/§18 this is a deterministic 'no line' state with a named reason, not an error condition.

key_inequalities: Highs strictly decreasing: 100,98,96,...,72 -> zero pivot highs.
Eligible second-anchor set empty -> NO_VALID_SECOND_ANCHOR, no geometry.
geometry_check.notes: Locks the 'no valid line' outcome as a first-class, named state rather than an error.
